links.outcome: LLM accuracy on diagnosis, medication and treatment tasks when patient and doctor race and gender were varied
links.effect: Significant disparities in accuracy and bias across models and tasks. Llama 3.1-8B was more sensitive to demographics, especially in diagnosis. Largest accuracy drop for Hispanic patients treated by White male doctors.
links.quote: Notably, we observe the largest accuracy drop when Hispanic patients are treated by White male doctors, underscoring potential risks of bias amplification.

screen.reason: Empirical benchmark evaluation assessing demographic bias and fairness (race and gender perturbations) across two LLMs on the MedQA dataset without testing a specific deployment practice or guardrail.
